author: BustyBista
body: I've been on many spanish teams and I feel like I need to join an English team because I am english. My sword skills are really good (I've killed Huahwi a famous MCSG player who is ranked 12th on the leaderboards). My bow skills aren't that good but I am god at bow spamming. I bring a positive and calm atmosphere with me. I have a really good mic. I can really help any team with my skills, and I also follow the commands of the captain/leader. I don't really complain about what position I get (besides defense because I suck at it). I am really active, right on the brink of no-life I think. Thanks for reading my LFT.
